id: D18-0 gate: networks with the sub-frame input features, paired against the same networks without
author: first_agent (group manager)
why: D16-0 (ledger 2.38): a cross-fitted tree corrector reading the 215 sub-frame features reduced the z_axis head's out-of-fold error variance by 4.9 % (P 1.00) and the X-point heights by 1.2-1.3 % (P .96), where the same corrector without them (D10-0) found nothing. The fast coil signals therefore carry information on the vertical position that the 20 ms features lack. A corrector on top of the heads is the weakest way to use an input; the networks should read it themselves. The vertical position also enters the flux map directly (the axis move), so the flux coordinates are measured too.
design: Paired fits: four S16 members (recipe 16 and 24 = h, 30 and 31 = hx; original settings and seeds; training part only; no readout-bank refit) fitted twice per fold, arm P on the 367 table features and arm S on those plus the 215 sub-frame features (subframe_features.py bea1c161…; training c86cf095…, calibration and validation extracted the same way). fit_on_accelerators unchanged. Folds and reserved stems as protocol_kfold_oof_maps_20260929; five folds (kernel a: 0-2, b: 3-4).

measure.text: on every held-out frame the mean heads of the four networks of each arm and the squared error of their 64 mean flux coordinates; per head the pooled squared-error ratio S/P with a shot bootstrap (2000, seed 990); the same ratio for the flux coordinates; the D9 head proxy of the difference.

rule: PASS if the z_axis squared-error ratio S/P is <= 0.95 with P(S better) >= .95 and the flux-coordinate squared-error ratio is <= 1.0. PASS -> the sub-frame features are worth a refit of the recipe; that is a large job (all-data members, readout bank, a 195-net-scale build) and goes to the entrant with this result before anything is started. FAIL -> closed; the 20 ms table stays.
failed_fit_note: A member whose calibration flux R2 is below 0.999 in either arm is reported; the pair is still evaluated as fitted (both arms share the seed), no retry before the first evaluation.
exposure: D16-0 result known. No network with these features exists at freeze.
rule_3: DIII-D training data only; inputs only.
